Sam (AE): Passing Trifecta (TF-2245) to CS — signed today. Fast facts: 25 seats, private VPC, target dedicated pool May 1. Primary contact Anya (anya@trifecta.com). Renewal 2026-10-15. Pilot OK; blockers: SSO metadata and VPC IP allowlist.

Maya (CS): Ill take this. Need ACS/EntityID and who on their side owns cert rotation. Also want a short milestone plan to share with customer.

Sam (AE): Anya owns SSO. Shell provide metadata after we confirm ACS URL. IPs pending from their infra (10 business days typical).

Trent (Eng): Please open infra ticket for peering + static egress. We need expected qps and sample prompts to size the pool. Ticket by Apr 10 for May 1 target.

June (Enablement): I can deliver a 90-min ops + runbook session week of Apr 7. Maya, please send attendee roles.

Maya (CS): Created tracker: https://redwood.app/onboard/TF-2245. Owners: Maya (CS), Trent (Eng), June (Enablement), Sam (AE). Milestones: 1) IdP metadata (wk1), 2) VPC peering (wk2), 3) Canaries (wk3), 4) Go-live May 1. Adding 10 sample prompts + OKRs (<90ms median, zero P0 in 30d).

Sam (AE): Mitigation: offer hosted sandbox to unblock testing if peering slips >2w. Renewal risk medium until SSO+peering complete.

Handoff Bot: Workspace created https://redwood.app/workspace/TF-2245-onboard — runbook and templates seeded.

Maya (CS): Follow-ups assigned: Maya — customer comms; Trent — open infra ticket by Apr 10; June — draft enablement agenda; Sam — weekly exec sync until go-live. Ping here for blockers.
